The highest quality olive oil is extra virgin olive oil which must be totally unprocessed and kept below 75 degrees Fahrenheit at all times during the mechanical extraction process. To be certified as extra virgin, the oil must not only meet strict chemical criteria as defined by the International Olive Oil Council and adopted by the European Union and USDA, but also must have perfect flavor and aroma as determined by a certified tasting panel.
